purpose: Adversarial benchmark separating measurement-definition comparability from target/policy comparability. All contracts are synthetic, not a representation of any specific utility's full data system.

baseline.name: same-local-id-and-display-label
baseline.rule: measurement_comparability=comparable iff local_metric_id and label both exactly match; otherwise not_comparable
baseline.known_limitation: This naive comparator conflates display text with semantics and has no explicit unknown/target axis.
